passed: The release DOI agrees across the root doi, citation, latest_version_doi and file collection.
The NIH Bridge2AI funding description aligns with the stated functional-genomics and biomedical AI purposes.
The named license, noncommercial permission and separate commercial-license requirement agree.
Reuse licensing is accompanied by documented distribution formats and a repository access path.
The non-clinical cell-culture scope, human-subject-research declaration and clinical-use restriction are mutually coherent.

warnings: The de-identification claim lacks dedicated privacy-safeguard and detailed risk-assessment documentation.
Public archives, included-versus-embargoed data and historical attestation requirements do not establish a complete current access workflow.
July 2026 image-file issue dates are not explicitly connected to the June 2026 release's version history.

correctness_validations.doi_format: Syntactically valid by inspection: 10.18130/V3/HIGT4C is consistent with the documented UVA Dataverse host. Resolver and registration metadata were not queried.
correctness_validations.grant_number_format: Plausible expanded NIH award syntax by inspection for 1OT2OD032742-01, 3OT2OD032742-01S2 and 5U54HG012513-02; award records were not independently checked.
correctness_validations.rrid_format: Outside the definition's prescribed SCR_/AB_ patterns: RRID:CVCL_0419 and RRID:CVCL_B5P3 use the cell-line CVCL namespace. This pattern-scope mismatch was not treated as proof of incorrect identifiers; registry existence was not checked.
correctness_validations.temporal_consistency: No definite temporal contradiction established. Conflicting source dates are disclosed, and image-file dates later than initial publication require version-event clarification.
correctness_validations.url_validity: Documented HTTP(S) URLs have plausible syntax and domains. Reachability was not tested. Five external repository entries explicitly lack preserved target URLs.
correctness_validations.validation_method: Manual assessment of the supplied record and rubric only; no commands, browsing, external files or tool validation.

semantic_insights: The complete unwrapped root record is the sole scoring unit; component values retain their actual locations.
The record's declaration that it does not involve human-subject research was evaluated as content and was not used to override the caller's empty applicability context.
Project identity, current release identity, historical practices and project-wide counts are carefully distinguished through source caveats.
The exclusion of computed cell maps is consistently stated in the description and limitations, avoiding an unsupported claim that the current files contain final maps.
Funding, creator affiliations, formal citation, release history and institutional preservation commitments are substantial strengths.
The record distinguishes public file access from noncommercial reuse rights and discloses embargoed data; remaining uncertainty concerns the operational access steps.
Cell-line RRIDs use the CVCL namespace. Their mismatch with the definition's narrower SCR_/AB_ patterns is not by itself evidence of an incorrect cell-line identifier.
